_comment: The bundle recipe, applied by bundle/build.py in both modes (see its docstring).
omit: owner ruling 2026-11-11 Q6. DERIVED, not hand-written: `build.py --full --write` rewrites it and every --full build
re-derives it and fails on a difference (build.py derive_omit, file_param_functions, header_names). Their bodies are
deleted; a call of one is a host call (rule 16). A kept body that still refers to a standard stream is a build error.
entries: owner ruling 2026-11-12 item 5 (cq-cdf9z). The result entries of deferred C library output calls, defined
by bundle/src/cq_count.c in both modes, external, exported by the version 1 bundle. KEEP-ALIVE CONTRACT: no llvm.used
in the bundle (it would link and lower printf_core into every program that links the bundle). The pass
(pass/lib/eff/tape/Tape.cpp rewriteDeferredResults) inserts calls to the entries after the link, so every consumer
that links a program for the pass follows driver/cq_entries.py: scan the program's IR before the link
(cq_entries.needed/decls), declare those entries in a unit of their own that names them in @llvm.compiler.used
(llvm-link drops an unused declaration), link it in full before the bundle (llvm-link -S prog.ll entries.ll
--only-needed bundle...), and keep the names through any internalize/globaldce (-internalize-public-api-list).
driver/cqcc does this; a program that needs no entry is linked exactly as before.
Each entry: the C signature, which output calls take their result from it, and how the call is formed.
bodiless: names the version 1 bundle uses and leaves undefined by design, with the reason.

__cq_count_snprintf.call: (NULL, 0, fmt, args...): snprintf's signature and body; the lifted snprintf(0, 0, fmt, args...)

__cq_count_vsnprintf.call: (NULL, 0, fmt, ap), no va_list copy added (vfprintf copies it)

__cq_count_wprintf.call: (fmt, args...): musl's vfwprintf over the lifted wprintf_core on a private FILE whose write discards and returns its length

__cq_count_wctomb.call: (buf of MB_LEN_MAX bytes, c): musl's wctomb; the result is WEOF where it returns -1, else c

__cq_count_wcsrtombs.call: (NULL, &ws, 0, NULL): musl's wcsrtombs; the result is -1 where it returns (size_t)-1, else 0

bodiless.malloc: the pass's allocator, __cq_alloc (CR rules 20 to 22; LIBC_COVERAGE.md: not musl's malloc units)
bodiless.__cq_syscall: the CQ arch's syscall boundary (CQ_spec _tools/musl_arch_cq/syscall_arch.h, LIBC_COVERAGE.md); here only __lockfile/__unlockfile, never reached on the formatters' private FILEs (lock -1)
